name: Image Cache Tests
on:
  push:
    branches: [dev]
    paths: ['src/tooling/docker-build/**', '.github/actions/image-cache/**', '.github/workflows/image-cache-test.yml']
  pull_request:
    paths: ['src/tooling/docker-build/**', '.github/actions/image-cache/**', '.github/workflows/image-cache-test.yml']
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.4.2'
      - run: bun test src/tooling/docker-build/image-cache.test.ts
